question.worked_solution:
First, we convert the given probability into a cumulative probability:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X<-1)=0.3085\,⇒\,P(X\le -1)=0.3085\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le -1) & =0.3085 \\ P\,(Z\le \frac{-1-1}{\sigma }) & =0.3085 \\ Φ\,(-\frac{2}{\sigma }) & =0.3085 \\ -\frac{2}{\sigma } & ={Φ}^{-1}(0.3085)\end{aligned}
$$

According to the table, we have

$$
Φ(-0.50)=0.3085\,⇒\,{Φ}^{-1}(0.3085)=-0.50.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}-\frac{2}{\sigma } & =-0.50 \\ \sigma  & =\frac{2}{0.50} \\ \sigma  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

.
